definitions.actions: One-based decision step; only solvable nonterminal states; invalid choices count as errors.
definitions.progress: Executed actions, starting at zero; fixed cohort excludes start=goal.
definitions.reference: LLM answers on the saved map-greedy history; its answers are not executed.
definitions.greedy: Actual saved map-greedy trajectory, not the LLM reference answers.
definitions.dead: First executed action that makes the goal unreachable; invalid outputs are not physical dead ends.
